bill.title: A BILL for an Act to create and enact chapter 44-04.1 of the North Dakota Century Code, relating to prohibiting agencies from entering nondisclosure agreements concerning data centers and industrial projects; to provide a penalty; to provide an effective date; and to provide an expiration date.

action.description: Second reading, failed to pass, yeas 15 nays 32

posted_text:
🏢 ND SB 2406 — North Dakota Could Block New Data Centers – Here’s How

North Dakota could stop state agencies from locking up local communities with secret deals about new data centers and industrial projects. Currently, agencies can sign agreements with developers that keep information about massive projects – like energy use, water needs, and potential impacts – hidden from the public. This bill would ban those agreements, preventing agencies from approving projects without full transparency. ...
